## File: settings-export-menu.yaml
## Type: project menu
## Purpose: Menu exposing export-related settings (default type,
## allowed extensions, version suffix behavior) for the application.

metadata:
  udi: prismata.universe.menu.settings.export
  name: "Settings > Export Menu"
  version: "0.1.0"
  kind: menu
  description: "Submenu for export-related settings."

udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings-export"
kind: menu
type: "menu"
title: "Export Settings"

items:
  - key: "1"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.export.default-type"
    label: "Set Default Export Type"
    description: "Set default export type (for example: yaml, json)."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-export"
    setting_key: "default_export_type"
    value_type: "string"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "2"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.export.allowed-ext"
    label: "Set Allowed Extensions"
    description: "Set allowed export extensions as a list (prompt supports multi-value input)."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-export"
    setting_key: "allowed_extensions"
    value_type: "string_array"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - key: "3"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.export.auto-append"
    label: "Set Auto Append Version"
    description: "Enable or disable automatic version suffix appending on export."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-export"
    setting_key: "auto_append_version"
    value_type: "boolean"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null
